images.actual_source_analysis: A green alpine meadow with scattered purple, yellow and white wildflowers fills the foreground. A dark forested ridge rises toward a rounded crest at right, with pale blue layered mountains farther left behind it. One broad white cloud band crosses a clear blue sky diagonally. There are no people, buildings or writing.
